title: Dealer and Genius appointment coordination
summary: This topic mostly contains procedural mentions of contacting a dealer or BMW Genius, setting appointments, or noting that appointment follow-up is still pending.

negative.summary: Negative reviews describe unresolved issues where the customer had not made dealer contact or was only being asked whether the dealership had been contacted.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mainly mention planned Genius or dealer appointments, pending scheduling, transfers to the dealership, or support interactions without clear satisfaction or dissatisfaction.

limitations: Most examples are procedural and do not express clear sentiment, which limits interpretation.
The topic spans several related but distinct activities, including appointment scheduling, dealer contact, Genius support, and follow-up status.
